key_findings: TRPV4 and TRPM8 were consistently upregulated in painful periarticular tissue from CLBP patients, with increased nerve fiber infiltration.
TRPV1 transcripts were unmodified or decreased in some patients; one patient with prior interspinous implant showed no TRPV4/TRPM8 increase.
